question: The 2020 Nobel Prize for ‘Physiology or Medicine’ was awarded to _______ scientists who made a decisive contribution in the fight against blood-borne hepatitis.

• The **Nobel Prize** award was** first **conferred in **1901.**
 
• It is given in the name of **Alfred Nobel **who was a **Swedish inventor.**
 
• The season for Nobel Prize begins in **October **every year.
 
• The Nobel Prize is awarded yearly to individuals or organizations who do an extraordinary job in the field of** Physics, chemistry, literature, peace, physiology** or **medicine,** and **Economics.**
 
• All the Nobel Prizes are given in Stockholm, Sweden except for the Nobel Peace Prize which is awarded in Oslo, Norway.
 
• **Rabindranath Tagore** was the** first Indian citizen** to be awarded and also the first Asian to be awarded in **1913** and **Mother Teresa** is the only woman among the list of recipients.
